name: Buzz Voice
description: Live, reactive voice assistant for Buzz with barge-in, streaming replies, and pluggable LLM, STT, and TTS backends. Talk hands-free or push to talk, manage todos, and find threads by emoji.

args:
u=$1; m=${2:-whisper-1}; k=$3
f=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/bv-stt.XXXXXX") || exit 1
trap 'rm -f "$f"' EXIT
openssl base64 -d -A > "$f" || exit 1
if [ -n "$k" ]; then
curl -fsS --max-time 60 -H "Authorization: Bearer $k" -F "file=@$f;filename=audio.wav;type=audio/wav" -F "model=$m" "$u"
else
curl -fsS --max-time 60 -F "file=@$f;filename=audio.wav;type=audio/wav" -F "model=$m" "$u"
fi

d=${1:-$HOME/buzz-voice-models}
case $d in "~/"*) d=$HOME/${d#"~/"};; esac
n=${3:-small.en}
v=2.0.1
r=https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/download
e=false; if [ -x "$d/sherpa-onnx/bin/sherpa-onnx-offline" ] || command -v sherpa-onnx-offline >/dev/null; then e=true; fi
m=false; [ -f "$d/sherpa-onnx-whisper-$n/$n-tokens.txt" ] && m=true
if [ "$2" = install ]; then
set -e; mkdir -p "$d"; cd "$d"
case $(uname -s) in Darwin) p=osx-universal2;; *) p=linux-x64;; esac
if [ $e = false ]; then
echo "progress engine"
curl -fsSL "$r/v$v/sherpa-onnx-v$v-$p-shared-no-tts.tar.bz2" | tar xjf -
rm -rf sherpa-onnx; mv "sherpa-onnx-v$v-$p-shared-no-tts" sherpa-onnx; e=true
fi
if [ $m = false ]; then
echo "progress model"
curl -fsSL "$r/asr-models/sherpa-onnx-whisper-$n.tar.bz2" | tar xjf -; m=true
fi
fi
s=null; c="$HOME/Library/Application Support/com.blueoakinteractive.buzz-voice/settings.json"
[ -f "$c" ] && s=$(cat "$c")
printf '{"engine":%s,"model":%s,"buzzVoice":%s}\n' $e $m "$s"

d=${1:-$HOME/buzz-voice-models}
case $d in "~/"*) d=$HOME/${d#"~/"};; esac
p=$d/venv/bin/python3
v=$d/silero_vad.onnx
ok() { [ -x "$p" ] && [ -f "$v" ] && "$p" -I -c 'import sherpa_onnx, numpy' 2>/dev/null; }
if [ "$2" = install ] && ! ok; then
set -e; mkdir -p "$d"
command -v python3 >/dev/null || { echo '{"runtime":false,"error":"no-python"}'; exit 0; }
echo "progress runtime"
[ -x "$p" ] || python3 -m venv "$d/venv"
"$p" -m pip install -q --disable-pip-version-check sherpa-onnx==2.0.1 numpy >&2
[ -f "$v" ] || curl -fsSL -o "$v" https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/download/asr-models/silero_vad.onnx
set +e
fi
if ok; then echo '{"runtime":true}'; else echo '{"runtime":false}'; fi

command -v say >/dev/null || exit 127
f=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/bv-say.XXXXXX") || exit 1
trap 'rm -f "$f"' EXIT
if [ -n "$1" ]; then
say -v "$1" -r "${2:-190}" -o "$f" --file-format=WAVE --data-format=LEI16@24000 -f - || exit 1
else
say -r "${2:-190}" -o "$f" --file-format=WAVE --data-format=LEI16@24000 -f - || exit 1
fi
openssl base64 -A < "$f"

u=$1; k=$2
f=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/bv-tts.XXXXXX") || exit 1
trap 'rm -f "$f"' EXIT
if [ -n "$k" ]; then
curl -fsS --max-time 60 -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Authorization: Bearer $k" --data-binary @- -o "$f" "$u" || exit 1
else
curl -fsS --max-time 60 -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary @- -o "$f" "$u" || exit 1
fi
openssl base64 -A < "$f"

d=${1:-$HOME/buzz-voice-models}
case $d in "~/"*) d=$HOME/${d#"~/"};; esac
m=${3:-kokoro-en-v0_19}
r=https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/download/tts-models
has() { [ -d "$d/$m" ] && ls "$d/$m"/*.onnx >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f "$d/$m/tokens.txt" ]; }
if [ "$2" = install ] && ! has; then
set -e; mkdir -p "$d"; cd "$d"
echo "progress tts-model"
curl -fsSL "$r/$m.tar.bz2" | tar xjf -
set +e
fi
if has; then echo '{"ttsModel":true}'; else echo '{"ttsModel":false}'; fi
